text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-82371 fired -> HIGH - canary error rate spike on embed-service (region: eu-west-1)

pagerduty: @maya paged for HIGH severity incident PD-82371 (10% error rate threshold breached)

maya (oncall): acked PD-82371 :hand:

maya (oncall): saw the alert, jumping in. anyone on deploy?

kevin: I pushed the canary of the new tokenizer/quant branch ~7m ago, traffic ramp started at 6m.

alex: confirmed, canary pods show 5xxs and grpc errors to tokenizer. logs show OOM-ish stacks then retry floods.

sasha: product-alerts: we have a few customers reporting higher latencies in eu-west-1 (support tickets #4432, #4435). Could be related.

maya (oncall): ok — priority: stop rollout and divert traffic off canary. kevin do you have quick rollback?

kevin: yes. canary flag is controlled by rollout service. running: 

```bash
# drain canary
rolloutctl set-weight embed-service:canary 0 --region eu-west-1
# divert to stable
rolloutctl set-weight embed-service:stable 100 --region eu-west-1
```

kevin: running drain now (started at 1778880065).

incident-bot: action log: rolloutctl set-weight executed by kevin @ 1778880068 -> canary weight -> 0

pagerduty: escalated to SRE on-call after 3m unacked escalation window (PD-82371)

alex: while traffic drains, i'm attaching recent stack trace snippet.

```
E tensorflow::Allocator: failed to allocate 512MB, trying smaller chunk...
... at tokenizer.cc:312
grpc::Status: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED
```

sasha: customer-impact estimate: ~2% of requests in region affected in last 10m, some downstream retries causing backend p99 latency increases. CS is notifying affected accounts.

maya (oncall): thanks. kevin, if rollback is done, we should run smaller canary but not the quanted tokenizer. revert to previous image.

kevin: starting image rollback to embed-service:v1.14 (previous) via k8s rollout restart on stable.

ops-runbook-bot: runbook step 1: divert traffic -> OK. step 2: rollback image -> in progress. remember to disable auto-ramp for 30m.

kevin: rollback applied at 1778880120, stable pods back to v1.14.

alex: monitoring: error rate trending down to baseline; CPU on canary hosts still high due to retries but no new canary traffic.

incident-bot: PD-82371 status: acknowledged by maya, escalated once, mitigation in progress (traffic diversion, rollback).

maya (oncall): quick checklist: 1) confirm rollback successful (kevin) 2) verify customer impact closed or reduced (sasha) 3) capture logs for postmortem (alex) 4) handoff if not resolved by next rotation (maya)

sasha: CS updated tickets, impact flags added. product-alerts: tracking incident with customers A, C, D. No major revenue impact flagged, but degraded UX.

kevin: confirm rollback health: stable p99 latency 220ms, error rate <0.5% in eu-west-1.

maya (oncall): great. i'll keep PD open until we stabilize and then assign to triage for postmortem. any immediate follow-ups?

alex: need a reproducer for the tokenizer memory spike — will run local repro and attach heap profiles.

sasha: ask CS to keep customers updated with ETA for root cause.

pagerduty: PD-82371 -> mitigation confirmed, not resolved. awaiting postmortem assignment.

maya (oncall): setting follow-up actions: 1) kevin: revert deploy pipeline to block quanted tokenizer for auto-canary (ticket #INT-921) 2) alex: attach logs + heap dump to ticket #INT-922 3) sasha: customer comms + impact summary (INT-923) 4) oncall: run a synthetic sweep across eu-west-1 for 1h to confirm stability.

kevin: filing INT-921, pushing policy change to rollout config now.

alex: uploading traces to internal S3 path and linking in INT-922.

sasha: CS notified customers with interim workaround steps.

ops-runbook-bot: reminder: create a short post-incident blameless summary and tag eng-runtime, eng-ml.

maya (oncall): handing off to kevin for follow-up ownership for the next 4h, i'll be off rotation after that. kevin please take lead.

kevin: taking over follow-ups. i'll keep PD open and update.

pagerduty: PD-82371 -> note: next escalation window at +60m if not resolved.

maya (oncall): thanks all. closing immediate page. will add notes to oncall log. :white_check_mark:

sasha: heading to sync with CS and product to align messaging.

kevin: will run validation sweep and confirm rollback policy change applied by 1778881500.

alex: will start postmortem draft once reproducer validated.

incident-bot: thread archived for PD-82371 mitigation steps recorded.
